annotations.title: Get a live score and box score

description: Read the in-play or final score and box score for one game (eventId from search_markets or the board), the same read as the app’s Live game page: status (in_progress, final or suspended), period and clock, each team’s score and period-by-period line, team statistics, and player statistic tables. state unavailable with a reason (e.g. unsupported_league, no_usable_body when the game has not started, source_stale) means the app shows no box score either. Covers the leagues the app’s Live game page covers, soccer included.
name: get_box_score
title: Get a live score and box score
